title: Few physicists in the crash-retrieval program

tellings.quote:
Like your
last interview pointed out how few
physicists there were for the retrieval
program.

plain: A secret US program to recover crashed craft is said to have had very few physicists working on it. A NASA engineer named Charles Buhler brings this up, pointing out to Michels that Michels' own previous interview had made the point. If true, it would suggest the program lacked the scientists needed to understand what it found.
